title: Storage quota
tagline: Uploads go over the quota and deleting a file doesn't free any space.
lookFor: The limit check must include the NEW file: `used + size > limit`.
Change the 'used' number in the database, not in a copy.
Replacing a file: take away the old size, then add the new one.
Exactly at the limit is OK.

bugs.symptom: Upload that would exceed the quota is accepted
hints: Does the check include the size of the file being uploaded?
bugs.cause: It only checks current usage, so any upload fits while you're under the limit.

bugs.symptom: Deleting a file doesn't free space
bugs.cause: It only changes a copy in memory.

bugs.symptom: Hidden test: Re-uploading the same name double-counts
hints: If the file already exists, how much should usage change by?
bugs.cause: It adds the full new size without taking away the old one.
